notes.title: RX Racing 2022 Pro (Update #1)
notes.content:
[b]First update of the game which includes :[/b]

- The sounds of the engines , whether electric or thermal , have been revised . I wanted an electric sound that was a bit louder and more realistic like this one

[url=https://youtu.be/8hv0P8eoR94]Superpole World RX Spain[/url] 


- New updated from the Unity game engine which is the most recent one 

- Added in the "Control/Graphics" menu how to launch a race because there is a graphic bug that I left because there was no consequence on the game and no need to say that the game is broken



 And also one last thing , when you do a review you should play at least the new features of the game which takes well over 10 minutes and if you see a bug , stop amplifying the thing by making it look like it is broken . [b]Also , when you buy a game , you can always get your money back if you don't like the game .[/b]
For the trailer , it's true that it's dated because I made it the day of my preparation to release it on steam and well before making the gameplay videos which are more recent and with the latest features and which are available on my YouTube channel .

notes.title: RX Racing 2022 Pro is out now !!!
notes.content:
[b]The new game RX Racing 2022 Pro is out with new features :[/b]

[u]Game :[/u]

- new interface to select the different game modes

- you can play with two different controllers ( only during the race )

- you can choose 8 different graphics from Very Low to Master

- add two new championships : RCenter and Finland

- ARC and INRX become E-ARC and E-INRX : two new electric championships

[u]Track :[/u]

- add three new tracks : Dreu , Strengnas and Hel

- add of a podium

- more credible walls

[u]Car :[/u]

- new car for Gronolm in RNordic

- new team and car in E-INRX

- new electric sound for electric car 

- new livery for Godfree

[u]Race :[/u]

- 5 different spotters 

- you can stall on the grid 

- new start on the grid for E-INRX

- the other drivers are faster

- some drivers have an ultra-aggressive ability : when they want to overtake, they do so, even if it is to push you or other drivers off the track

Or if you buy on Itch.io  you can get ad more this game , a steam key
[url=https://caracing-studio.itch.io/rx-racing-2022-pro]Itch.io[/url]


[u]Trailer & Gameplay :[/u]

[url=https://youtu.be/UsgmK8TwyB0]Trailer RX Racing 2022 Pro[/url]

[url=https://youtu.be/TcxMxE1r1OE]E-INRX[/url]

[url=https://youtu.be/4cuIhCACV3M]E-ARC[/url]

[url=https://youtu.be/8xq3yqw5P84]UK Rallycross[/url]

[url=https://youtu.be/5HQ5-9LBx7o]RNordic[/url]

On this , good racing =)

notes.title: RX Racing 2022 Pro
notes.content:
RX Racing 2022 Pro is an arcade rallycross game where you can drive the drivers of the year 2022 in different categories. The goal is very simple, you take a driver and try to win the race . 



New features :

Game :

- new interface to select the different game modes

- you can play with two different controllers ( only during the race )

- you can choose 8 different graphics from Very Low to Master

- add two new championships : RCenter and Finland

- ARC and INRX become E-ARC and E-INRX : two new electric championships

Track :

- add three new tracks : Dreu , Strengnas and Hel

- add of a podium

- more credible walls

Car :

- new car for Gronolm in RNordic

- new electric sound for electric car 

- new livery for Godfree

Race :

- 5 different spotters 

- you can stall on the grid 

- new start on the grid for INRX

- the other drivers are faster

- some drivers have an ultra-aggressive ability : when they want to overtake, they do so, even if it is to push you or other drivers off the track

[url=https://youtu.be/UsgmK8TwyB0]Trailer RX Racing 2022 Pro[/url]

notes.title: Race On Ice 2022 Pro
notes.content:
Race On Ice 2022 Pro is out !!!


New by report last game Race On Ice 2020 Pro :

- New electric car for Silvin Compétition's team
- A grid of 5-6 to 6-7 cars
- R.O.I Lite is back
- Update of circuits with some new and the correct of trucks's size and pit sign


Feature :

- 3 Modes


Season :

- Season 2021-2022 of R.O.I Pro

14 drivers 6 teams and 6 tracks

Race with 6-7 cars Season 5 races

- Season 2021-2022 of R.O.I Lite

14 drivers 6 teams and 6 tracks

Race with 6-7 cars Season 5 races


Also if all is okay , there will be a update :

- AI Car
- A new car in R.O.I Pro
